verdict.rationale: Raygun documents several of the story's building blocks. Deployment tracking is pitched for spotting new errors and regressions per release (raygun-docs-31). Errors can be ranked by occurrences and users affected, and filtered by date and version (raygun-docs-3). An error chart shows frequency and trends over time on search results (raygun-docs-19), and there is a Crash Reporting dashboard with export (raygun-docs-9). Nothing in the pack shows a leadership dashboard that rolls trends up across projects and teams, so the cross-org view in the story goes unevidenced. Missing for 10: cross-project/team aggregated dashboards, an explicit new-issues-per-release report or a ranked top-regressions view, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
